title: feat(console): approvals thread UI — reassign, remind, request-info, reply, SLA chips, step progress
body:
## Summary

Companion to objectstack-ai/framework#1740 — the collaboration layer of mainstream approval centers (ServiceNow / SAP Fiori My Inbox / DingTalk-Feishu), all verified end-to-end in the showcase browser session.

- **转签 Reassign**: dialog with a user datalist (free text accepts emails / `role:<name>`); on success the row leaves "My Pending" and the timeline logs `admin@… → ada@…`.
- **催办 Send reminder**: submitter nudge; the 4h server cool-down surfaces as a humanized toast, not an error code.
- **退回补充 Request info**: third decision button — request stays pending, submitter notified; amber timeline entry with the ask.
- **Thread replies**: inline reply box under the activity timeline (submitter + approvers); comments render as quiet slate entries.
- **SLA chips**: list rows + drawer show "SLA 32h left" / red "SLA overdue 3h" from `sla_due_at`.
- **Step progress**: compact stepper (✓ done / ● current / ○ upcoming) from `flow_steps` between summary card and timeline.
- 22 new `approvalsInbox.*` keys across all ten locales (parity test green).

## Test plan

- `@object-ui/i18n` 100/100 ✅ · console suite 3558 passed ✅ · `tsc --noEmit` clean ✅
- Browser e2e: reassign via dialog (badge 3→2, waiting-on chips update, timeline entry), remind throttle toast, request-info → comment thread visible with authored text, stepper ① Manager Review ● → ② Executive Review, SLA chips in both list and drawer ✅
